title: Talarico warms to Trump, says he wants to help fulfill some MAGA promises
summary: James Talarico told the "Diary of a CEO" podcast he'd work with Trump on healthcare, housing and childcare despite months of attacks from the president.

title: Trump says Israel will stop receiving $4B in US aid by year's end, can still buy weapons
summary: President Donald Trump says Benjamin Netanyahu raised the idea of ending $4 billion in U.S. military aid to Israel by the end of the year.

title: Federal judge tosses Trump admin Harvard admissions lawsuit, leaves door open to future challenge
summary: A federal judge dismissed the Trump administration's lawsuit against Harvard University over admissions records, citing procedural deficiencies.

title: Mamdani threatens to sue Trump admin over ICE's use of city-owned lots for immigration enforcement
summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani threatened legal action against ICE over agents allegedly staging immigration enforcement operations in city-owned parking lots.

title: Battleground Dem touts bipartisan record, but can’t name single issue she’d work with Trump on
summary: Democratic Senate candidate Peggy Flanagan touted her bipartisan record but couldn't name one Trump policy she'd support, citing "continued grift."

title: 7 holiday shopping scams to watch for this season
summary: Black Friday deals are already drawing scammers who use fake delivery notices and gift card payment requests to steal your personal financial information.

title: Americans urged to avoid dangerous border state despite US lifting shelter order
summary: Officials have lifted a shelter-in-place order for Matamoros, a Mexican city across the border from Brownsville, Texas, but Americans are still being urged not to travel to the region.

title: Mariners hire 36-year-old Jason Kanzler as new manager after disappointing season
summary: The Seattle Mariners tapped 36-year-old Jason Kanzler as their 22nd manager after his three seasons leading Chicago Cubs player development.

title: Chris Cuomo says talking about politics makes it difficult for him to avoid violence

title: Tiger Woods to redesign famed Long Island golf club that was rocked by prostitution scandal
